Chapter 8: The Power of the Spoken Word—Declarations and Commands
Let’s dive into one of the most fascinating forces in our lives—spoken language.
Words aren’t just labels for things—they’re creative tools. Every time you speak with conviction, your words become blueprints, shaping your world and giving your subconscious—and even the universe—specific instructions to follow.
Think of it like this: imagine a conductor leading an orchestra. When the conductor’s movements are clear and intentional, the whole orchestra plays in harmony. But if the conductor just waves the baton around aimlessly, chaos follows. The same thing happens with our words. When we speak carelessly, we invite confusion. But when we’re intentional, life tends to respond in kind.
So, how do you harness this creative power? It all comes down to using declarations and commands—speaking with clarity and authority, especially when things feel uncertain or challenging. Instead of saying, “I hope things work out,” try declaring, “I am guided to the right solution.” Can you feel the difference? That subtle shift from wishing to commanding signals a deeper trust in yourself and in life.
Here are a few ways to put this into practice:
Daily declarations. Start your day by setting a clear intention, like, “Today, I welcome new opportunities.”
Commanding outcomes. When you hit a roadblock, use strong, affirmative language: “This situation is resolved in perfect order.”
Blessing others. Offer words of encouragement and goodwill to those around you—your words have real creative power.
And don’t forget to guard against idle speech. Notice when you slip into negative or self-defeating talk, and gently steer your words in a more empowering direction.
Here’s something to remember: the true power of declarations comes from your emotion and belief. When words are spoken with genuine feeling, they carry much more weight. Over time, this habit of intentional speech will reshape not just your mindset—but also the circumstances around you.
Consistency is key. If you declare abundance one minute but complain about lack the next, you’re sending mixed messages—and that weakens your intention. By lining up your words, thoughts, and actions, you become a much more powerful creator in the game of life.
So, as you move forward, pay attention to the language you use. Speak with purpose, and watch how the world starts to respond to your lead.
